name: agentic-scaffold
description: Scaffold agentic best practices into any repo: AGENTS.md as the canonical instruction file, a CLAUDE.md compatibility wrapper, README.md, CHANGELOG.md, DECISIONS.md, ROADMAP.md, adaptive editor configs and a session-closeout runner. Each skill carries a growth stage; session-closeout is evergreen, while init, nest, logchange and repo-audit are budding (known gaps; don't rely on them to scaffold projects for others yet). See the README's Modules table.
